subject: Sentinel POC: observability plan, metrics, and owners
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: Claire Jensen <claire.jensen@acme-inc.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 18 Oct 2026 15:12:00 +0000
Subject: Sentinel POC — post-call recap & proposed observability scope

Thanks Claire — great discussion today. Per our call, here’s a concise recap and proposed plan for the 6-week POC focused on inference observability and production readiness for Acme Payments.

Summary of objectives (what success looks like)
- Latency SLO: 95th percentile inference latency < 220ms for peak traffic profile (payment validation workload).
- Error budget: API error rate < 0.5% over a rolling 24h window for policy-evaluations route.
- Cost target: token cost per eval reduced by >= 15% vs current baseline through batching/quantization recommendations.
- Functional checks: correct structured outputs for 95% of the 100-sample prompt set you’ll provide.

Observability scope we recommend for the trial
- Dashboards: per-route latency P50/P95/P99, tokens-per-request histogram, ML model confidence distribution, throughput (rps) and tail latency heatmap.
- Traces: end-to-end distributed traces for a single request from your frontend to Redwood inference runtime, including KV cache hit/miss spans.
- Logs: structured request/response logs (redact PII) exported to your Splunk/Datadog; include request_id, model_version, batch_size, and node_id.
- Alerts: P95 latency breach, error-rate spike, and KV-cache-miss rate increase alerts — with suggested thresholds in the attached checklist.

Ownership & timeline (proposed)
- Week 0 (Kickoff): alignment session, access and secrets exchange, confirm test dataset. Owner: Aditya / Acme platform lead.
- Week 1–2 (Instrument): enable tracing & log export, deploy dashboards read-only. Owner: Redwood (Marissa) + Acme infra.
- Week 3–4 (Load/Eval): run synthetic and sampled production traffic, collect metrics and prompt evaluation outputs. Owner: Acme + Redwood SRE (Vanessa).
- Week 5–6 (Analysis): finalize pass/fail against success criteria, handoff recommendations and cost optimization plan. Owner: Joint.

Attachments: poc-success-metrics-template.xlsx, observability-checklist.pdf (see attached).

Next steps
1) Please confirm the success criteria above or send edits (esp. error budget & latency SLO).
2) Share the 100-sample prompt set and a short list of representative routes (route names and example payloads) by Tue 10/20.
3) Proposed kickoff: Wed 10/21 at 10:00am PT — 45 min. Please confirm attendees.

If you’d like, we can add Jamal (security) to the kickoff to cover log retention and export controls.

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
aditya_rao@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0123

From: Claire Jensen <claire.jensen@acme-inc.com>

Date: Sun, 18 Oct 2026 18:05:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Sentinel POC — post-call recap & proposed observability scope

Thanks Aditya — this is helpful and close to what we discussed. A few clarifications from our side: 

- Latency SLO: the 220ms P95 sounds reasonable but can we also track P99 for the highest-value payment route? We’ll want a separate alert there.
- Error budget: we want both 24h and 7d rolling windows for the error-rate checks.
- Ownership: please include our security lead Jamal Ortiz (jamal.ortiz@acme-inc.com) on the kickoff — he’ll confirm log retention and redaction requirements.

Two asks:
1) Can you confirm whether Redwood will push the tracing spans to our Datadog tenant or if you prefer us to pull via export? We prefer push.
2) We have a non-negotiable: data egress for logs must remain in our EU/US region selections (we’re in the US). Please document where logs are stored.

I’ll check availability for Wed 10/21 and confirm.

—Claire
Claire Jensen

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Claire Jensen <claire.jensen@acme-inc.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Cc: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 19 Oct 2026 10:22:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Sentinel POC — post-call recap & proposed observability scope

Hi Claire — looping in more specifics from the observability playbook so we can lock the POC plan. Answers inline and an owner map at the bottom.

Tracing approach
- We will instrument the inference runtime to emit OTLP spans and can push directly to your Datadog via agent or send to a customer-managed collector in your VPC. For the POC we recommend push to your Datadog (minimal infra changes). Include span attributes: request_id, model_name, model_version, prompt_hash (hashed), kv_cache_hit (bool), node_id, batch_size.

Log export and retention
- Logs will be exported as structured JSON; Redwood supports region-scoped export endpoints. For this POC we will push logs to your US Datadog tenant and can set retention to match your policy. If you'd like logs to remain entirely in a customer-managed S3 bucket we can write to S3 instead (we will only send non-PII fields).

Dashboards & Metrics (what to build in week 1)
- Overview: live throughput (rps), total tokens/min, cost-estimated tokens per minute.
- Latency charts: P50/P95/P99 per-route; rolling windows (1m/5m/1h); histogram for tokens-per-request.
- Model health: confidence score distribution, tail-error classification (model_fault vs infra_error).
- Cache effectiveness: KV cache hit ratio time-series and per-model stats.
- Alerts: examples — P95 > 220ms for route X for 5m, P99 > 500ms (critical), error-rate > 0.5% over 10m and >1.0% over 1h (auto-escalate).

Sample alert thresholds (we can tune after baseline run)
- P95 latency > 220ms for 5m
- Error rate > 0.5% (10m) or >1.0% (1h)
- KV cache hit ratio drop > 15%

Evaluation plan & ownership (week-by-week)
- Week 0 (Kickoff): Data access, secrets exchange. Owners: Aditya + Claire + Jamal (security).
- Week 1: Instrumentation completed, dashboards provisioned (Marissa).
- Week 2–3: Smoke tests + synthetic load (Acme infra), collect initial baselines (Vanessa).
- Week 4: Real-traffic sampling & evaluation against prompt set (Marissa + Acme).
- Week 5: Optimization recommendations and cost runbook (Redwood PM + Acme).

Deliverables for acceptance
- Dashboard link (read-only) with required panels.
- Tracing samples for 1000 sampled requests with annotated failures.
- An evaluation report showing metrics vs success criteria and recommended next steps.

Owner map (quick)
- Redwood instrumentation & dashboards: marissa_cole
- Redwood SRE & log pipeline: vanessa_ortiz
- Acme infra & approvals: Claire Jensen
- Security & retention signoff: Jamal Ortiz (cc on kickoff)

I attached a dashboard mock (dashboard-mock.png) and the SOW/kickoff agenda draft (sow-kickoff-agenda.docx). I’ll update the thresholds after the first 48h of baseline data.

Cheers,
Marissa Cole
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

- Example alert tuning we plan to test during Week 2: P95 >220ms for >5m, KV cache miss rate increase >12% for 10m.
